jobs.title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineering
jobs.description:
About DataCamp

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you’ll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education.

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps.   • Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines.
  • Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors.
  • Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content.
  • Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale.
  • Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, pr

jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Go SDK - Language Clients
jobs.description: About the team The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. The role We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own ClickHouse's Go clients. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep Go expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: clickhouse-go and ch-go, and the collectors, pipelines, agents and tools that write millions of rows per second through your code. jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
jobs.description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen. Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn. Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek
